printing_conventions.convention: hamzat wasl written as bare alif or with the wasla sign
a hamza seat that already encodes the vowel may be printed without it
a hamza with sukun after a damma: spelt out on a waw seat (تحقيق) or merged (تسهيل)
printing_conventions.example: أُؤْكَلُ = أُوكَلُ (أكل p.133, أله p.175, أصل p.195)

printing_conventions.convention: a hamza with sukun after a kasra-ed wasl alif: spelt on a ya seat or as ya
the short vowel before its long counterpart may be written or left off
printing_conventions.example: فَعَلَا = فَعَلا, decided per page and per class (see upstream SOURCES.md)

printing_conventions.convention: a retained و or ي after its short vowel may carry an explicit sukun
printing_conventions.example: يُوْصَلُ = يُوصَلُ (وصل p.155), اِيْقَظْ = اِيقَظْ (يقظ p.222)

printing_conventions.convention: a final sukun may be omitted
